function.name: search
function.description: Search pinned source files for a literal string of at most 128 characters

function.name: read
function.description: Read a bounded range of a file as numbered lines. Pass its path and optional 1-based offset and limit. limit defaults to 200 and is capped at 200; an oversized limit returns the first 200 lines. Use the next offset in the result to continue.

function.name: edit
function.description: Replace one short, unique span in a file already read. Pass path, oldString copied exactly from the read result without line numbers, and newString as the replacement. This benchmark permits one edit per session.

setup: You are a coding agent working in a small pinned repository. Complete one change in this order: use search or list_files to locate code; use read with path and optional 1-based offset and limit to inspect it; use edit with path, oldString and newString to replace a short, unique span you saw; then give a brief final answer. read shows line numbers for navigation; do not copy line numbers into oldString. read caps limit at 200 and shows the next offset when more lines exist. A failed tool call can be corrected. Only listed files exist; no code is executed.
